name: Battle before the gate
description: Composed from the saved Troy revisions (wall section and breached wall, city gate with doors sampled open, house, temple hall, galley, chariot, horse, wooden horse, Trojan/Greek soldier, Hector, Achilles, shield, bow set). Y up, wall line along X at Z=0, plain toward +Z. Each asset or formation is baked once from sampled clip poses to one mesh per material and instanced with shared geometry; gate doors and the wooden-horse hatch stay separate named nodes. 125 draw calls, 208k triangles.
brief: The composed scene: gate and wall, houses and the temple behind, both armies on the plain, chariots, ships on the shore and the wooden horse. Repeated pieces are instanced.

findings.message: Tested 64 of 348 overlapping part pairs: 229 involve parts that could not be measured, 55 were beyond the analysis budget (64 booleans, 128 solids). Unreached pairs were not examined; the most overlapping bounding boxes were tested first.

56 part-volume measurements were unavailable. 26 because compound solid exceeds the component budget or contains an unsupported inward shell: "Wall_breached_-18_m0", "TempleHall_m1", "Galley_1_m1", "Galley_1_m2", "Galley_2_m1" and 21 more. 30 because a valid closed solid could not be measured (Not manifold): "Galley_1_m0", "Galley_1_m3", "Galley_2_m0", "Galley_2_m3", "WallDefenders_W_m1" and 25 more. 229 overlapping part pairs include one of these parts and were not measured. These parts are not certified clear.

metrics.partVolumeScope: Visible static closed mesh pairs, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes intra-mesh intersections, motion, open surfaces and usable passage space. Positive overlap may be intentional.

findings.message: 15 images exceed the 4-image web.portable.v1/standard budget. Reuse approved resource IDs, remove unused images, or atlas compatible same-color-space slots; never atlas normal/data maps into an sRGB image.
